thread:
maria: quick note — opening a per-route analytics with model-level cards causes big cold-loads (p95 ~2.2s). Client issues route summary then N model metrics calls.

cecil: saw that too. the UI waits for all model calls before painting the chart which hurts perceived load.

owen: backend proposal: add a single /api/console/route_view_aggregate that returns route summary + model slices in one shot. we can include sampling hints and a small meta block declaring whether we honored the full request.

tara: product question: should saved-queries store a preference for this? i.e., users can opt into "show model-level metrics". if default on, we risk burning customers' telemetry budget.

maria: suggestion: saved_query.prefetch_mode = "off"|"route_only"|"models_on_demand"|"full_if_budget". default = "off" for new orgs, "full_if_budget" for enterprise trials.

cecil: API sketch: GET /api/console/views/{id}?prefetch=full_if_budget&model_sample=0.15&cache_seconds=20
Response contains: data payload (route + models) and meta string: "prefetch_status":"served_full"|"sampled"|"downgraded"; "model_sample_used":"0.15"; "quota_signal":"ok"|"throttled". Also set header X-Prefetch-Status: downgraded when not full.

owen: ops asks we tag these calls for billing: meter name console.view.telemetry_v2 with org_id and view_id. also emit an event when downgrade/sample happens and when cache was used.

tara: UX copy: Checkbox label: "Show model-level metrics (may use telemetry budget)". Tooltip: "If your org has limited telemetry allowance, model metrics might be sampled or hidden. We'll show a badge if that happens." Also show an inline small cost hint: "Est. extra telemetry: low/medium/high" rather than a precise number at first.

maria: client should read meta and render a small inline banner: "Detailed metrics sampled (using 15% of data)" or "Downgraded to route-level due to quota". that helps users know why numbers may be coarse.

cecil: cache idea: session-scoped S-W-R key (org+user+view) to keep a combined payload hot for quick navigations. still need billing pings on cache hits. maybe a lightweight POST to /api/console/telemetry/ping that charges a token but returns minimal payload when cache served.

owen: i'll implement aggregate endpoint + X-Prefetch-Status header. i'll return meta as strings so client doesn't need to infer. prototype on staging this week.

billing-bot: confirm: include meter console.view.telemetry_v2 and emit events: telemetry.used, telemetry.downgraded, telemetry.cache_hit. include view_id in tags. doc will be uploaded to billing playbook.

tara: rollout plan: behind feature flag, saved-query schema change to persist prefetch_mode, client surfaces banner + badge, billing meters live. default off for free tier, enable auto for beta orgs.

console-bot: perf snapshot: staging with aggregate endpoint -> median load 370ms (baseline 2.2s), p95 880ms (baseline 3.4s). test id: agg-prefetch-2026-03-23.

maria: owners: owen backend PR, cecil client + schema change, tara UX copy + figma, billing-bot metrics. i'll file umbrella ticket with acceptance criteria and link owners.

cecil: i'll also add a telemetry debug panel in the view details showing sample_rate_used and quota_signal for power users.

maria: cool. let's keep defaults conservative and make opt-in simple for power users. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

end of thread
